subject: Retain highest counts of individuals with assessTemporalIndepedence()

messages.author: 47db1de7b44832a8
messages.subject: Retain highest counts of individuals with assessTemporalIndepedence()
parts:
Hi,

I've got a large number of images that were taken in quick succession with varying numbers of individual animals in each image. When using the function assessTemporalIndependence(), it uses the "lastIndependentRecord" which could be as little as n=1 individuals in the image and removes rows with counts of up to n=9.

Is there any way that I could retain the row with the highest count of individuals in the image? Such as that instead of using the "last independent record", it uses the record with the highest count number specified in an "abundance" column.

All the best,
Seb

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Retain highest counts of individuals with assessTemporalIndepedence()
parts:
Hi Seb,

if you have the images and not just the record table, you can run recordTable() with arguments "eventSummaryColumn" and "eventSummaryFunction".

These two arguments are also passed to assessTemporalIndependence(), so you can also use them there. But that function is less reliable since it is only intended as an internal function.

Best,

Jürgen
